# ISO Standard

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A standard published by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).

## Scope note

Covers standards such as ISO 25964 (thesauri and interoperability), which the SKOS Editor's validation and hierarchy materialization draw on.
